verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection are a fair axis for a SaaS invoicing and payments platform, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region or data residency. The ACH and Organizations items concern payment methods and multi-account views, not where data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
